endpoints.name: Get All

endpoints.name: Delete Warranty Card

idempotency.notes: Repeating the call after success will typically return not-found or no change

endpoints.detailed_description: Delete warranty card. It validates the request, then calls ICommon.getUserByToken, IWarrantyCard.GetWarrantyCardById, ICommon.ToJsonString, then writes an audit log entry. Persists changes to: WarrantyCard: UPDATE, soft delete (is_deleted flag), AuditLog: INSERT. Possible responses: 200, 400, 401, 404, 500.

error_handling.validation_errors: 400: Valid lead ID is required. [when id <= 0]; message returned by the called service/repository (result.Message)
error_handling.not_found: 404: Warranty Card not found. [when existingWarrantyCard == null]
error_handling.unauthorized: 401/403: Unauthorized: Invalid or missing token. [when current_user == null]

ai_agent_guidance.use_when: When the user wants to delete warranty card
ai_agent_guidance.do_not_use_when: When the user only wants to view data, or the required inputs are not available yet

business_logic.operation_summary: Delete warranty card — validates the request, calls ICommon.getUserByToken, IWarrantyCard.GetWarrantyCardById, ICommon.ToJsonString, writes an audit log entry
business_logic.preconditions: Valid Bearer JWT; route parameter(s) id must reference existing record(s); passes 3 validation/business rule check(s) (see validation_rules)
business_logic.state_changes: WarrantyCard: UPDATE; soft delete (is_deleted flag); AuditLog: INSERT
business_logic.side_effects: AuditLog DELETE (Coustomer Relationship Management > Warranty Cards > Warranty Cards); AuditLog DELETE (Customer Relationship Management > Warranty Cards > Warranty Cards)
business_logic.depends_on_user_context: Resolves the current user from the JWT (getUserByToken / claims)

validation_rules.message: message returned by the called service/repository (result.Message)

endpoints.name: Create Warranty Card

idempotency.notes: Not idempotent; repeating the call may perform the action again

endpoints.detailed_description: Create warranty card. It validates the request, then calls ICommon.getUserByToken, IWarrantyCard.GetDealerById, IWarrantyCard.GetUserById, then processes uploaded files. Persists changes to: WarrantyCard: INSERT, ComplaintsFile: INSERT. Possible responses: 200, 400, 401, 404, 500.

error_handling.validation_errors: 400: Valid dealer ID is required. [when request.DealerId <= 0]; Customer name is required. [when string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(request.CustomerName)]; Valid contact number is required. [when request.ContactNumber <= 0]
error_handling.unauthorized: 401/403: Unauthorized: Invalid token. [when currentUser == null]; Unauthorized: Invalid token. [when currentUser == null]

ai_agent_guidance.use_when: When the user wants to create warranty card
ai_agent_guidance.do_not_use_when: When the user only wants to view data, or the required inputs are not available yet

business_logic.preconditions: Valid Bearer JWT; request body of type CreateWarrantyCardDto (inline); passes 4 validation/business rule check(s) (see validation_rules)
business_logic.state_changes: WarrantyCard: INSERT; ComplaintsFile: INSERT; sets existingInvoice.invoice_no, existingInvoice.purchased_date and saves changes
business_logic.validations: Valid dealer ID is required.; Customer name is required.; Valid contact number is required.
